name: @cardo/cardo-updater
description: Cardo update-check logic: probes the npm CLI dist-tag and the cardo GitHub release, decides whether an update is available, and persists the user's skipped version. Pure (no Electron imports) so the decision semantics are unit-testable.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "test/**/*.test.mts"
